title: Soil DNA Extraction Modified Protocol for Dryland Agroecosystems
author: McKenzie L. Stock
materials: The DNA is now ready for downstream applications.

This protocol is modified from the Qiagen manufacturer protocol for the DNeasy PowerLyzer PowerSoil Kit . DNeasy PowerLyzer PowerSoil Kit (DNA Extraction Kit, Qiagen, 12855-50, https://www.qiagen.com/us/products/discovery-and-translational-research/dna-rna-purification/dna-purification/microbial-dna/dneasy-powerlyzer-powersoil-kit/ ) .

steps.title: Store Soil Samples
steps.instruction: Store soil samples cold, at least -20°C (ideally at -80°C).

steps.title: Prepare Homogenization Vial
steps.instruction: Fill a 12 ml homogenization vial (Spex SamplePrep 6133PC-T) approximately 2/3 full with soil and include three 6.35 mm diameter chrome steel beads (BioSpec Products Cat. No. 11079635c).

steps.title: Homogenize Soil
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample using the SPEX SamplePrep 1200 Genolyte homogenizer with the single-vial attachment for 12mL vials.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize at 4000 rpm for 00:00:10.
Re-homogenize as needed at 4000 rpm for 00:00:10 to prevent soil from thawing and sticking together.

steps.title: Prepare PowerBead Tube
steps.instruction: Transfer soil and reagents into the PowerBead Tube.

substeps.instruction: Add approximately 80 µL of soil sample by volume to the PowerBead Tube.
Add 750 µL of PowerBead Solution to the tube.
Add 60 µL of Solution C1 and invert several times or vortex briefly.

steps.title: Perform Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Process the PowerBead Tubes using the Spex 1200 Genolyte homogenizer.

substeps.instruction: Place the PowerLyzer Glass Bead Tubes into the tube holder attachment (holds 6), ensuring tubes are balanced.
Run at a time and RPM suitable for the soil type (e.g., 3000 rpm for 00:00:35).

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation and Transfer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the Bead Tubes at 10,000 x rcf for 00:03:00.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (expect 400-500 µL) to a clean 2 ml collection tube.

steps.title: Perform Solution C2 Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the supernatant with Solution C2.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL of Solution C2 and vortex for 5 sec.
Incubate at 2-8°C for 5 min.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x rcf for 1 min.
Avoiding the pellet, transfer up to 600 µL of supernatant to a clean 2 ml collection tube.

steps.title: Perform Solution C3 Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the supernatant with Solution C3.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of Solution C3 and vortex briefly.
Incubate at 2-8°C for 00:05:00.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x rcf for 00:03:00.
Avoiding the pellet, transfer up to 750 µL of supernatant to a clean 2 ml collection tube.

steps.title: Prepare for Column Loading
steps.instruction: Add 1200 µL of Solution C4 to the supernatant and vortex for 00:00:05.

steps.title: Load MB Spin Column
steps.instruction: Load the supernatant onto an MB Spin Column in three separate loads.

substeps.instruction: Load 675 µL of supernatant and centrifuge at 10,000 x rcf for 00:01:00; discard flow through.
Add an additional 675 mL [sic] of supernatant and centrifuge at 10,000 x rcf for 00:01:00.
Load the remaining supernatant and centrifuge at 10,000 rcf for 00:01:00.

steps.title: Wash Spin Column
steps.instruction: Wash the column twice with Solution C5 to minimize salt contamination.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl of Solution C5 and centrifuge at 10,000 x rcf for 00:00:30; discard flow through.
Repeat the wash: add 500 µL of Solution C5 and centrifuge at 10,000 x rcf for 00:00:30; discard flow through.
Centrifuge again at 10,000 x rcf for 00:01:00.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the spin filter.

substeps.instruction: Carefully place the spin filter in a clean 2 ml collection tube, avoiding splashing Solution C5 onto the MB Spin Column.
Add 50 µL of Solution C6 to the center of the white filter membrane.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x rcf for 00:00:30.
Discard the MB Spin Column.
